hypotheses.reasoning: account-svc v1.5.0 started rolling out at 17:41:18 (#89) and was ready at 17:41:51 (#95). Before that, logins returned 200. From 17:43:14 on, some POST /login requests crash in account-svc with an unhandled TypeError (reading 'currency' of undefined at user-formatter.ts:132), and every one is tagged [v1.5.0] (#103, #114, #121). edge-proxy then passes these on as 500s (#104, #128, #152, #165). The failures are partial, which fits new formatter code that breaks only for users whose record has no currency or billing sub-object. Nothing else looks wrong: accounts-db shows only routine vacuum and checkpoint lines, there is no migration in the logs, and auth-svc, session-cache and audit-consumer log no warnings or errors.

Another reading is that some user records are genuinely missing the currency/profile field. But the errors only start after the v1.5.0 rollout and I found no migration or data change, so a regression in the new code is the more likely explanation.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll account-svc back to v1.4.9. Then fix user-formatter.ts:132 in v1.5.0 so it handles users with no currency or billing object, and add tests for users without that data before redeploying.
